title: AI Game Dev strategies used by the community.
author: rodriguezcappsec
selftext: Hello everyone! I am developing a game using Claude + PhaserJS + React + Vite, It's a 2d top down RPG, and I wonder if there are recommendations or strategies you all use.

comments.author: 3pumps1load
comments.body: My main focus are skills/agents and hooks when working with Claude code. I have hooks to always keep handoff files to resume state without exploding context. Also, specific agents/skills for each part helps a lot in the context handling part.

replies.author: GlitteringJob9248
replies.body: does it increase quality of output? i was mostly using 1 shot right now and with opus, i think it is reaching bottleneck tbh

replies.author: 3pumps1load
replies.body:
Never one shot. AI is not a magical tool. It can do a lot but only if guided correctly. Think of it as a junior dev. They can do stuff, but with limited context, overblown working hours and vague requests, they can’t do nothing. AI always has to provide an output so in that case it will just make stuff up. 

Take whichever process you want to automate, break it down into small specific pieces and then use AI
